## Evidence

The live rendered Belgian pages, not stale search snippets, show:

- `B2WI-035BE`, EAN `4711377434270`: €3495.79 including VAT, more than 20 in stock, ships within 24–48 hours; 290HX Plus, RTX 5080 16GB, 32GB as 2x16, 2TB and full-P3 500-nit OLED. This reinforces `CONFLICT`; it cannot be normalized by majority vote. The 5080 page consistently states 290HX Plus.
